summary: Controlled interface for manual code entry, with an optional host-provided viewport.
whenToUse: Collecting a ticket code for a check-in flow managed by the consumer.
whenNotToUse: Accessing the camera or scanning codes: the component does not do this.

props.name: scannerViewport
props.description: Optional scanner content created and managed by the host.

inherits: HTML attributes of <section> except title and onSubmit.

keyboard.action: Reaches the field and submits a valid code from the button or with Enter.

accessibility: The manual field is associated with a label; the button stays disabled when the code is empty or the component is disabled.
responsive: The manual field and the button wrap when space is limited.
customization: Uses --dc-* tokens and className on the container.
commonMistakes: Do not pass components that open the camera without host-provided consent and logic.
limits: No camera access and no scanning performed by the component.
